title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: The Carrying Booking at the Review Decision
content:
## Clause

A review decision under Dangerous Goods Acceptance also looks at the booking the goods travel under, as the booking record stands when the decision is taken. Three things must be true of it:

- its container type is one the category permits;
- its port of discharge is not one of the ports the category refuses;
- it is recorded as a dangerous-goods booking and is live, live meaning a status of requested, confirmed or equipment released.

## Condition grid

| Booking record shows | Container type test | Port test | Live dangerous-goods booking test |
|---|---|---|---|
| permitted type, accepted port, dangerous goods, confirmed | passes | passes | passes |
| permitted type, refused port, dangerous goods, requested | passes | fails | passes |
| permitted type, accepted port, dangerous goods, gated in | passes | passes | fails |
| permitted type, accepted port, general cargo, confirmed | passes | passes | fails |

## Points of judgement

**The booking has been gated in. Is it still live for the decision?** No; for this test only requested, confirmed and equipment released count as live.

**The booking was moved to a different port of discharge after admission.** The port the booking shows at the decision is the one tested.
